questions.text: Distinguish a label from an opcode in assembly code.

answer.text: A label names a location for reference

questions.text: Explain the purpose of a conditional branch.

answer.text: Changes the next instruction if a condition or flag is satisfied
Otherwise execution continues to the next instruction

questions.text: A register contains 00110100. Give the result of a logical left shift by two positions, using eight bits.

answer.text: Zeros are inserted on the right; high bits falling off are discarded

questions.text: What is the result of 10101010 AND 00001111? Explain a use of this operation.
